nom: Youth To The People Superfood Cleanser - Kale + Spinach Hydrating Face Wash

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective, and Refreshing—Great for Daily Use
avis.texte: I received this product through the Vine program, and this review reflects my honest and unbiased experience after using it twice daily for a little over two weeks. I’m familiar with cleansers designed for sensitive and combination skin, so I was interested to see how this formula—with kale, spinach, and green tea—compared to others I’ve used. I incorporated it into my usual morning and nighttime routine, using warm water and about a dime-sized amount each time. This cleanser stands out for how gentle it is while still being effective. It removes everyday buildup and light makeup without stripping my skin or leaving it feeling tight. The gel texture lathers nicely, and a little goes a long way, which makes the bottle last longer than I expected. The antioxidant-rich formula feels soothing on the skin, and after consistent use, I noticed a subtle improvement in clarity and brightness. My pores looked slightly more refined, and my skin felt balanced rather than dry or overly oily. I also appreciate that it’s sulfate-free and has a clean, natural scent that isn’t overpowering. The refillable packaging is a thoughtful touch for anyone trying to reduce waste. While it removes most makeup well, heavier or waterproof products may still require a separate remover. Also, those with extremely dry skin might prefer a more hydrating cleanser, depending on their routine. Youth To The People’s Superfood Cleanser is a high-quality, gentle daily wash that supports clean, balanced, and refres

This facial skin cleanser always makes me laugh when I read the print on the bottle! “Kale + Green Tea, Spinach, Vitamins: Superfood Cleanser.” Sounds like I should be DRINKING this stuff! How healthy can you get? But in all seriousness, Youth To The People facial skin cleanser is indeed healthy. I have sensitive skin, and this cleanser is gentle and magical. A very small amount will cleanse your skin while moisturizing as well. The fragrance is fresh and pleasant. My understanding is that some people have problems with the pump. Fortunately, I have never had a pump problem. All I’ve ever had is great facial skin cleansing! If you think it’s too expensive and you want to try a “knockoff” product, that’s up to you. I have found that I need so little of the cleanser that Youth To The People is NOT expensive. I sincerely hope you will try it.
I LOVE this face wash! It is so fresh and clean-feeling. My skin doesn't feel dry after using it. I also love the light fresh scent.

avis.titre: A good, clean face wash for sensitive skin
avis.texte: The cleanser overall seems to work well. The gel is thick when it comes out of the pump, but lathers up VERY easily - so a little goes a long way. The smell is a nice "clean" smell. It's not super strong or overpowering, which I personally love. It also seems to cleanse the makeup off my face well. I have very sensitive skin and I was hoping it would help more with hormonal breakouts. I can't say that it say caused any breakouts, but I can't speak to whether or not it helps to prevent breakouts. I think this face wash is great for probably all skin types!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I absolutely love this face cleanser! It leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and flawless. It removes impurities without drying out my skin and gives my face a fresh, healthy glow. I’m very happy with this product and would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: Perfection! Coming from someone with super sensitive skin!Perfection! Coming from someone with super sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin and for years as someone who does love skin care and all, this is one out of only three brands that’s actually work for me! It’s so gentle in my skin and helps a lot to control any breakouts if they ever come up, even if it’s just a pimple or two, it’s super good at cleansing and gentle and in general just fantastic for anyone with sensitive skin! It’s worth the money and I genuinely recommend it! I first tried it with a sample birthday box thing from sephora and it was the small size and ever since then I’ve been wanting to get my hands back on this and finally bought it, really really love this. I have been using this again for a good bit now and my skin feels smoother and even small bumps that come up literally have gone away! It’s worth the love and hype 100%!!!

My daughter bought my first bottle & I’ve used it ever since. It’s gentle, with a scent just as gentle. I’m impressed how long a bottle lasts, it takes such a small amount, I use every morning & night.
Best face wash. Not all sensitive skin is made the same but mine likes this face wash! Clean but not dry! Worth every penny.

Yes the price is a little high, BUT you get a huge amount and this is one of the most gentle cleansers ever. You can open your eyes mid wash and they won’t sting. I have sensitive skin and I reacted to Cerave, the Ordinary, and others but this one is my holy grail so I decided to go back to it and I’m not switching it for anything else anytime soon.
It was so expensive, I realise too late Sephora have the same one in half price, and I’m not pretty sure about the quality, at first it was smooth but some days later it just turned liquid

This was recommended by a friend, I think it smells like fresh cut grass. I double cleanse. First with a face oil and then I’m using this. Skin feels dry if I don’t apply moisturizer but it feels clean and my pores are smaller with no blackheads, but it could be because of the double cleansing and maybe not the result of this alone.
Product received was either not authentic or has gone bad. Not the same feel, smell, or efficacy of other bottles I have received.

avis.titre: Finally found a facial cleanser I like enough to buy again!
avis.texte: I’ve been using this cleanser daily for a few months now and feel like I finally have a cleanser I can keep using! It does a great job at getting my face clean without drying it out. I like that it has a very gentle feel and doesn’t leave a tight or irritated feeling after use. It also seems to help break down a grimier-than-usual face. I appreciate that it doesn’t have a super harsh scent, but still smells nice. Overall I’d say it’s a great everyday face wash that hits all its marks, and I love the glass pump bottle too.

I had been eyeing this product for quite a while and decided to finally purchase. The scent is light and not overwhelming, the thickness is good and lathers nicely when using. I was nervous because I do have sensitive skin but it’s been about two weeks and my skin is loving all these natural ingredients!

Great product, quick shipping however the product packaging seems to be already tampered with. The box was already opened when arrived although the Amazon packaging seems unopened. The bottle had tumbled out but thankfully not spilled. It made me question if this is original

I love love this face wash but unfortunately the pump broke in the shipping process. My skin has felt more moisturized and the soap foams easily which is one of my favorite parts. I love that it is an all natural face wash and includes great simple ingredients. I also love that the product is in a glass bottle. Definitely recommend getting the face wash just maybe not from amazon because the product broke and was not bubble wrapped or anything.

This cleanser is amazing super gentle but leaves my face feeling really clean and refreshed. It doesn’t strip my skin or make it feel tight, and I love that it’s packed with good ingredients like kale and green tea. A little goes a long way, so it’s worth the price. Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Hands down the best face product
avis.texte: I'm very picky on what I wash my face with. I've tried alot of products but haven't found the right combination that doesn't leave my skin too dry or too oily. I was a little hesitant because of the product, but it was 100% worth it. I don't have to use much to cover my face and neck, I only have to use it once a day, and it leaves my face feeling clear. Also it's organic and you can tell when it's going into your pores, it's not artifical chemicals. It's nature doing its best.

I saw a lot of bad reviews about this product so I was a little suspicious, but I definitely don’t regret this purchase. It foams up super well, doesn’t leave my face feeling dry and dehydrated after use, and when I used this product along with my moisturizer, my skin has never felt so soft in the morning. Definitely will be buying again.

I have very sensitive skin and eyes. This version of the Superfood Cleanser is watery, foams too quickly, leaves my skin dry and tight, and irritated my eyes. Previous bottles I purchased were creamy, gentle, and hydrating. Be aware that the formula seems to have changed.
I have been using this office for awhile now and love it. The only con is that the pump seems to always be messed up with every one I purchase.

I have a combined to oily skin and has been looking forever for a good face wash and this one is to die for! You get an 8 oz bottle (which is really big), so its a really good value. The product is good for all types of skin and 1 to 2 pumps is enough for a wash (which is so little!!)

avis.titre: Be sure you get what you pay for.
avis.texte: This product must not be the real product - look at the font writing on the bottles. Was very watery when opened and the top pump doesn't work. Box delivered opened.

avis.titre: The flavor is immaculate 10/10 will eat again
avis.texte: I swear by this cleanser, it’s amazing and gets you results fast! Not to mention the packaging is glass which is better for the environment. Oh, and did I forget to add they threw in their Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream in for FREE! It was such a pleasant surprise!
I’m giving this one star - I can’t even use it properly because I can’t get the stupid pump to deploy. It’s either me or the product. I’m blaming the product.
It’s really good for sensitive skin not a strong scent and a great price for the size!! will definitely purchase again
I actually look forward to washing my face with this Superfood Cleanser! It smells so fresh and leaves my face clean and nurished.

avis.titre: Not what it is cracked up to be
avis.texte: I read an article in NYT Wirecutter about how great this product is. It is expensive and basically if you have even a bit of makeup on your face it won't clean it. The picture is after I used it along with a cleansing brush and this was the result. All I had on my face was powder and blush that I had put on 12 hours earlier. I would not recommend this.

Good product but I'm absolutely displeased with how the product was packaged and delivered. The cap was broken as seen in the pictures posted. For a container that is glass which is very fragile I expected it to have a package that has more cushion. Not pleased at all. ☹☹

avis.titre: Gentle for my combined skin type
avis.texte: I like that doesn’t stripping dry my face and not too foamy, my face feel fresh and clean after using this, definitely recommend

This is extremely watery. Might as well be pumping out water, literally. Except, it smells like urine. It has cloudy junk in it. It even looks more yellow than the advertisement suggests. It’s also very drying. But why does it smell like urine!? It’s way too expensive to be buying urine water. Really. Never buying again. Throwing away. GROSS.
The product is amazing, unfortunately lost half of the bottle to the shipping box.
I bought this product for our daughter in law. It did not come in a sealed package. I have no proof of what’s inside of this container so she will not be getting it very dangerous unsafe!!!

Was excited to try this because of all the good reviews I saw! I even bought the larger 8oz bottle. However, it was shipped without the original YttP box, without the pump (it just had a cap) and had no freshness/safety seal when you took the cap off. Feels like someone opened it and shipped it off-gross. Requesting a replacement

avis.titre: No integrity. Contrived corporate policy to increase profit by making every. Single. Bottle leaks.
avis.texte: Lost tons of product due to faulty pump. Again. Third time. The company responded the first time but ignored me when I explained I got it 3rd party from Amazon. Why did I buy the 3rd? Because I love the cleanser. It smells like earth and torn lettuce. It's gentle And cleans well(use a toner after. The cotton is never dirty after a wash). I am so irritated at this company. I really love it but the lack of integrity and responsibility is disgusting. They owe me 120$. AND an apology.

So I’d love to give this cleanser 5 stars as I love the scent, the concept and the company sounds great however, the pump doesn’t work. Trying to fix the pump was messy and it still doesn’t work. Normally this wouldn’t be a big deal but it’s a heavy glass bottle which I just know I’m going to drop.

When I opened my box I notice it was sealed as it should be but inside the bottle cap was loose and the product spilled. Pretty much 30% of the content is gone. I don’t know if this was Amazon or YTTP package management but my product is no at the quality as someone expect.
Provide top came broken , was really excited to try this out.

avis.titre: New Pump is cheap, but love the product!
avis.texte: Love this product, but new pump is cheap. Came to me broken so rather than go through the hassle of replacing it, I just poured my new product into my old bottle and kept my old pump which is significantly better. The newer bottle is bigger though, but same amount of product.

avis.titre: It’s totally broken. How can I return it?
avis.texte: It’s totally broken and I can’t return it. What should I do? How can I get a replacement?
Haven't tried the product yet, it just arrived. However it leaked all over the box.... pretty disappointing, especially for the cost..
I really wanted to love this cleanser but I have beyond sensitive skin and this cleanser ended up breaking me out in a horrible skin rash..
All the product is gone and the container was completely broken.
This didn’t come with a pump as shown in the picture!!!! Please send me one this is terrible!

avis.titre: Dawn dish soap for your face
avis.texte: So I've had this for about mmmmm 3-4 months now? And don't get me wrong it smells A-MAZING! (My 4 year old daughter is obsessed with it) smells like everything I SHOULD be eating in a salad lol; but dude this is like put dawn dish soap on my face. Maybe this is good for people who have oily skin? That can really scrub a dub dub there face? But I have sensitive rosacea skin (white girl problems) so when I was using this, I had to legit rub, lather, rub and repeat just to get the layer of soap to "render" down(with water), and THEN came the suds. I legit was washing my face for like 5-10 min with this soap! Ooph it dried my face out like crazy. Thankfully I follow the ten ste Korean skin care regime or jeez my face would be SO DRY. So honestly I only use this after I put a clay face mask off because I know it will get everything off, but I definitely don't recommend it for dry sensitive skin. Btw I'm half American/half Salvadoran with primarily European roots (Spain, England ect.) so i don't have a lot of breakouts, in fact I have the opposite of dry sensitive skin (rosacea, karatosis pilaris) 😩 wouldn't recommend it for dry sensitive skin.
Great product. I use daily as my first cleanser. But if you go to the actual website for Youth To The People the product is literally half the price. Save the money.

The three stars on this review are for the product only. It is fine but I am just as happy with other gel-like cleansers at a third of the price. Now let's talk about the container. In my shower, on a rack, I have several cleansers another one in a glass bottle and two are plastic bottles one with a pump and the other with a pump but a different style. After a couple months, the Youth to the People cleanser changed to a watery consistency as well as a more clear color instead of a green shade. I stopped using it because it was literally like a bottle of soapy water at this point. However I left it in my shower to observe, and over the course of about a month or two the level has increased from being about the middle of the V to above the S. So this is somehow literally filling with water even though other bottles on the same shelf are completely fine. The other brand product in a glass bottle is a dark amber shade and completely normal consistency. I live by myself so this is not a matter of someone filling it up with water because they used it all LOL. Somehow water is getting into this container even thought its not sitting directly under a stream.

I’ve purchased this product 3 times because it is safe for my perioral dermatitis prone skin. However, I was surprised to see this time the bottle already had the pump attached. Usually, it would have the flat screw cap on and the pump would be included for you to put on yourself: I’m not sure if this is something the company changed since my last purchase, but I don’t quite like it. Product appears the same however. It is thick, foams up quickly and leaves my skin feeling clean. Moisturize afterwards and use it up ! After a while the color changes and it does get a little runny.

This isn’t the worst cleanser in the world, but there’s definitely better out there. It isn’t worth the price, I don’t look glowy, fresh or brighter after, and it really dries my skin out. I would skip this one. The bottle is pretty cute though.

I received a trial size of the super food cleanser and fell in love after the first use. My skin feels super clean and not dried out afterwards. After a week of use, my skin looks clearer and redness has reduced. The product is lightly scented, but not offensive. It is pricey, but a little goes a long way. I pair it with the air whip moisture cream. My only complaint is the packaging. There is no seal on the bottle when you take the cap off. I received my order with a crack in the cap and there was some product leakage. It does arrive with a pump to use.

Very expensive to not get the advertised amount of face wash. I haven't put the pump in yet but I can't imagine it would fill the bottle to above the KALE lettering, let alone get to the curve of the bottle.

avis.titre: Yea, its a no for me!
avis.texte: Received package that was not sealed and obviously opened and tampered with. The nozzle was dirty which means whomever opened it and replaced the sealed cap with the nozzle had dirty hands… In no way would I use this on my face.
